limitations: CSV uses UTF-8/comma RFC4180; XLSX accepts bounded1900-date workbooks, not XLS/XLSM,1904-date books or formula cells. Convert unsupported evidence to verified CSV; no guessing.
Statements are complete period files with header opening/closing balances; overlapping periods are rejected. Bank feeds/OCR/FX/provider integrations are outside this task.

Partial allocation is supported only between same-sign actual bank and GL cash movements. Fees/netting/exchange differences require genuine separate canonical adjustments, never invented split journals.
Full reconciliation requires existing Accounting Admin/Accountant authority plus Payroll ledger coverage. Management Viewer is denied complete confidential bank data, not shown false partial totals.

Direct bank adjustments cover evidenced gross fees with no input VAT claim and non-taxable interest. Taxable/other liabilities or supplier/customer settlements use their existing canonical workflows, then match. No arbitrary journal editor or automatic tax recovery.
A reversed adjustment remains immutable; it cannot be reposted blindly. Correct replacement uses the supported canonical business workflow and is matched separately.
Production runtime acceptance remains pending explicit hosted101 activation and compatible frontend publication. No real records changed.
